name: Sorayama Natsume
source:
Sophomore at East School. A member of the floriculture and horticulture club. She transferred to the school in the third semester of her freshman year. She is from the Kansai area. She is seen by others as kind, modest, and neat. However, there is a little bit of a strange side to her.

During the summer vacation, she manages a field adjacent to the swimming pool for practical training by herself, and asks the members of the swimming club if they would like to eat vegetables harvested in the field together. She seems to have special feelings for Hajime.

[From [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/ciel/soranoiromizunoiro/]official site[/url]]
